requirement_text: The system shall provide personalized movie recommendations based on content similarity.
The system shall allow users to search for movies by title.
The system shall calculate similarity scores between movies.
The system shall display recommended movies through a web interface.
The system shall support deployment through a cloud-based hosting environment.
The system shall preprocess movie datasets before recommendation analysis.
The system shall maintain a similarity matrix for recommendation generation.
The application shall support interactive user input for movie selection.
The system shall support secure API-based communication.
The system shall support scalable cloud-based processing for trading signal analysis.
The system shall calculate financial risk using Monte Carlo simulation.
The system shall process user requests through AWS Lambda functions.
The application shall provision scalable cloud services using AWS EMR.
The system shall support configuration management through cloud APIs.
The system shall provide risk analysis results to users through a web interface.
The system shall support reusable cloud infrastructure resources.
The application shall monitor cloud execution performance and cost efficiency.
The system shall securely manage cloud credentials and configurations.
The pizza ordering system shall allow customers to order multiple pizzas.
The system shall calculate the total order price in Euros and US dollars.
The application shall maintain a shopping cart for customer orders.
The system shall collect delivery addresses and customer contact details.
The application shall support at least eight pizza menu options.
The system shall display the final order summary before confirmation.
The application shall support frontend interaction using ReactJS.
The backend system shall manage pizza order processing workflows.
The application shall support persistent order storage using a database system.
The system shall validate customer input before order confirmation.
The vehicle rental system shall calculate rental costs based on rental duration.
The system shall calculate insurance costs for rented vehicles.
The application shall support multiple vehicle categories including cars and motorcycles.
The system shall generate invoices for completed rentals.
The application shall calculate insurance discounts based on business rules.
The system shall collect customer rental information through user input.
The application shall support object-oriented vehicle management operations.
The system shall print detailed rental summaries for customers.
The application shall support secure server configuration management.
The system shall support firewall configuration and network protection.
The application shall support secure remote access through SSH.
The system shall support load balancing for web infrastructure services.
